import os,signal
me=os.getpid()
for name in os.listdir('/proc'):
    if not name.isdigit(): continue
    try:
        raw=open(f'/proc/{name}/cmdline','rb').read().split(b'\0')
        args=[x.decode('utf-8','replace') for x in raw if x]
    except Exception: continue
    if int(name)!=me and any(a.endswith('tools/run_research_distillery_entry.py') for a in args[:4]):
        try: os.kill(int(name),signal.SIGTERM)
        except ProcessLookupError: pass
PY
